Terranile / Biomedical intelligence
Biomedical intelligence

Make complex science more intelligible.

Project Helios explores how artificial intelligence can help researchers work with biomedical literature, biomarkers, disease mechanisms and complex biological relationships.

Project HeliosResearch initiative
Approach

From information to a clearer research question.

Biomedical knowledge is spread across papers, datasets and specialized disciplines. Helios investigates how computational systems can organize this information, connect evidence and assist researchers as they explore biological mechanisms. The objective is general-purpose biomedical intelligence infrastructure.

Scientific information

Explore methods for processing and connecting complex biomedical literature and information.

Biomarkers and mechanisms

Investigate relationships between biomarkers, biological processes and disease mechanisms.

Research assistance

Study computational approaches that help researchers frame questions and assess evidence.

Glaucoma research

Glaucoma is an important direction within a wider biomedical research initiative.

Helios is a research initiative. Its exploratory systems are not clinical diagnostic tools, and this website does not report validated clinical results or published Terranile research.
